function.name: user_mandates
function.description: Fetches the mandates associated with a user based on the provided user name and the status of the mandates. This API is intended for use by partners to retrieve information about their clients' mandates. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

name.description: The full name of the partner's client for whom to fetch mandates.

status.description: The status of the mandates to be fetched. If omitted, mandates of all statuses will be retrieved.

function.name: partner_mandates
function.description: Fetches the mandates associated with a partner based on the specified status. If no status is provided, all mandates are retrieved. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

status.description: The status of the mandates to be fetched. If left empty, mandates with any status will be retrieved.

message.content:
A **mandate** is an official authorization or instruction that gives someone the authority to act on behalf of another party. In different contexts it can mean:

| Context | What a mandate typically refers to |
|---------|------------------------------------|
| **Finance / Banking** | A formal agreement that authorizes a bank or financial institution to manage a client’s assets, execute trades, or handle transactions on the client’s behalf. |
| **Legal / Corporate** | A directive from a governing body (e.g., a board of directors) that empowers a manager or committee to make decisions within defined limits. |
| **Government / Politics** | An official commission or assignment given to a minister, agency, or organization to carry out specific duties or policies. |
| **General** | Any written or verbal instruction that grants someone the right to act for another person or entity. |

In short, a mandate is a clear, authorized instruction that defines who can act, what they can do, and under what conditions.
